name: lexis-phase9-vocabulary-mismatch-development
description: Development-only vocabulary-mismatch stress variants derived from four Phase 3 questions. Each variant preserves its parent question's intent and reuses the same previously verified stable evidence hashes; it is not a new held-out test set.

cases.question: What cumulative monetary easing occurred over the year ending in mid-2025?
cases.reference_answer: The MPC reduced policy rates by 1,100 basis points.
cases.notes: Vocabulary-mismatch variant of gov-policy-rate-reduction. Reuses its fixed Phase 3 evidence label and replaces policy-rate/MPC/basis-point wording with monetary-easing language.

cases.question: What support was designed to help small farmers recover from flood disruptions and adopt more resilient agriculture?
cases.reference_answer: It is intended to promote climate-resilient farming and provide liquidity support to small farmers affected by floods.
cases.notes: Vocabulary-mismatch variant of gov-climate-risk-fund-purpose. Reuses its fixed Phase 3 evidence label without naming Climate Risk Fund-I or microfinance banks.

cases.question: How broadly did the central bank's public money-skills initiative reach people, including women?
cases.reference_answer: Nearly 4.4 million people had been trained, half of whom were women.
cases.notes: Vocabulary-mismatch variant of gov-financial-literacy-reach. Reuses its fixed Phase 3 evidence label without the official program name or date.

cases.question: Which law clause requires the central bank chief's yearly report to be presented to lawmakers?
cases.reference_answer: It was submitted under Section 39(1) of the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956.
cases.notes: Vocabulary-mismatch variant of gov-statutory-submission. Reuses its two fixed Phase 3 evidence labels while avoiding the exact Governor's Annual Report and Parliament wording.
